page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries side by side, each printed line in its own entry. Printed page number at top right. Running head with a Hebrew letter at top left and top right. Catchword "& pl." at the lower right of the right column, signature "Bb 3" at lower left.

main_text.l: Hiph. 3. f. m. יִשְׁיַע, aff. Rad. יָשַׁע.
יִשְׁהָ cantabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. שׁוּר.
יִשִּׁשׁ gaudebunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. שׂוּשׂ.
יִשִׁית ponet, וַיִּשְׁתְּהוּ & ponet eum, יִשִּׁיתוּהוּ ponent eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. שׁוּת.
יִשְׁךְ, & יִשָּׁךְ mordebit, יִשְׁכְּנוּ eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָשַׁךְ.
וַיִּשְׁכּוּ & quieverunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שָׁכַךְ.
יִשְׁכַּת oblivioni tradetur, יִשְׁכְּחוּ oblivioni tradentur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁכַח.
יִשָּׁל dejicet, Job 27.8. vel tranquillus erit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יִשֵּׁל; Rad. נָשַׁל, vel pro יִשְׁלָה à שָׁלָה.
יִשְׁלְּךָ spoliabunt te, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יִשְּׁלֵךְ; Rad. שָׁלַל.
יִשְׁלִי quiescent, Pf.122.6. fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. (pro יִשְׁלוּ,) Rad. שָׁלָה.
יִשְׁלְכוּ dejicientur, pro יִשְׁלְכוּ, fut. Hoph. 3. pl. m. Rad. שָׁלַךְ.
יִשֵּׂם ponet, וַיִּשֶּׂם & posuit, יִשְׂמֵנִי ponet me, יִשְׂמְךָ te, וַיִּשֵּׂמֵם & posuit eos, וַיִּשְׂמוּ & posuerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. שׂוּם.
יִשֹּׁם obstupescet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יִשֵּׁם; Rad. שָׁמַם.
יִשְׁמַד perdetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁמַד.
יִשְׁמוּ obstupescent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שָׁמַם.
יִשָּׁמַע audietur, יִשְׁמְעוּ audientur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁמַע.
וַיִּשֶּׁן & dormivit, (pro יִשֵּׁן,) & יִשְׁנוּ dormient, Prov. 4. 16. (pro יִשְׁנוּ vel יִשֵּׁן,) fut. Kal, 3. f.

page.notes: Running head letters and the page number "107" are uncertain at this scan resolution; the page number may read "197". Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are copied only approximately, and several forms (notably the first entries and the points in the right column) are doubtful. The line "& pl." is the catchword, not running text.
